scripts.dev: VITE_AUTH_TOKEN=dev-local CTHULHU_AUTH_TOKEN=dev-local concurrently -k -n ui,backend -c blue,green "pnpm --dir ui dev" "uv run --project backend uvicorn cthulhu_backend.main:app --port 57173 --reload --reload-dir backend/src"
scripts.dev:desktop: VITE_AUTH_TOKEN=dev-local CTHULHU_AUTH_TOKEN=dev-local concurrently -k -n ui,electron -c blue,magenta "pnpm --dir ui dev" "pnpm --dir electron dev"
scripts.test: pnpm --dir ui test && pnpm --dir electron test
scripts.package:backend: uv run --project backend pyinstaller packaging/cthulhu-backend.spec --distpath packaging/backend-dist --workpath packaging/build --noconfirm
scripts.package: pnpm build && pnpm package:backend && pnpm --dir electron dist
